source_priority: Original black and white Lichess 300px sprites
Selected black candidate 2 enlargement for secondary detail interpretation

reference_camera.basis: Initial whole-set elevation from rook estimate; still an interpretation

geometry.method: Turned lathe pedestal; dense elliptical lofts for neck/head/jaw; remeshed continuous sculpt skin; swept oval-section mane and paired ears; recessed eyes, nostrils and mouth; bilateral neck channels

observations: Both original colors show the same low muzzle, arched mane, laid-back ear, cheek undercut and sloping neck channels.
Original white was mirrored and registered for a second silhouette check.
Side, front and opposite renders were visually inspected to verify substantial depth and continuity.
Final comparison lowered and deepened the cheek to match its undercut in both original sprites; original mean contour discrepancy is 1.38 source pixels.
limitations: The 54 degree orthographic camera, bilateral depth and unseen anatomy are inferred.
The shape and depth of ear cupping, cheek, nostrils and chest channels remain interpretations; silhouette overlap does not validate them.
Mane, ears, eyes and pedestal remain separately closed intersecting components.
Neutral clay lighting differs from the reference wood; no wood texture or grain has been reconstructed.
Browser rendering was not exercised; controls and exact camera projection were checked by the inherited Node VM harness.
